audit.whatIsWrong: Living Forge is never mentioned in either layer, and it has two consequences that decide how this lane is built and paced: Ornn gains bonus armour AND magic resist from all sources, and he can buy items anywhere on the map without recalling.
audit.why: The inflated MR is why raw AP under-performs here and magic penetration is not optional — this is the one top-lane opponent whose resistances grow faster than the item that bought them. And because he never recalls, the usual Kassadin plan of out-tempoing a reset does not exist: he leaves lane only when he chooses to.
audit.corrected: Written into the itemization block, phases[6].why, tldr, wants.foe[2] and content.late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says 'blink over his Q pillar' without saying why that works, and 'dodge the E dash-into-wall knockup' without saying the pillar IS the wall.
audit.why: Riftwalk is a blink, not a ground dash, so terrain between Kassadin and his destination does not intercept it — the magma pillar cannot wall him in. But standing between Ornn and any wall, pillar included, is what gives Searing Charge its knock-up, and airborne is the one state a blink cannot leave. The two halves belong together and neither was stated.
audit.corrected: Both written into spikes[1].text, whys[4], phases[3].why, phases[4].why, tradeBad, content.mid, breakdown.mid and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.why: Four fields, three verdicts, and the highest win rate in this slice. HARD is the least defensible of them.
audit.corrected: diffRating 5.5/10 to 3.0/10 and both rating lines reworded to 'Favoured'. full.diff itself is stuck — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0] to [6] are the generic Kassadin boilerplate; the two-item row promises 'the best scaling champion in the lobby' with no mention that the opponent's passive is quietly stacking magic resist against exactly that.
audit.why: Ornn is the one opponent in this slice where 'just scale AP' is actively the wrong instruction, and the scaling row is where a player would look for that warning.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [2], [3], [4] and [6] rewritten around the fissure's 800 range, the pillar-knock-up interaction and Living Forge's resistances.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Volcanic Rupture as matchup-defining and prints no cooldown for it or anything else.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s at 800 range, Searing Charge 14s to 12, and Call of the Forge God 140/120/100s. The nine seconds is the window the whole 'bait the pillar, then go' plan runs on.
audit.corrected: All three written into breakdown.cooldowns, plus tradeGood, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and All-In Windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Void Stone appears as '15% magic reduction' in spikes[3], content.late and whys[6]; content.mid and wants.you[1] claim Nether Blade gives a 'quintupled' mana-on-hit and spikes[2].text renders it as 'championrefund (5x mana on-hit)' with a missing space; phases[2].why carries the 'E only charges when spells fly' boilerplate; breakdown.late says 'Q-silence the counterplay'.
audit.why: Void Stone has been 10% since V11.24. Force Pulse stopped being charge-gated in V12.23 — it is a 21/20/19/18/17s cooldown that nearby ability casts shorten by a second each. Null Sphere has no silence. And no multiplier for Nether Blade's mana restore appears in Riot's description, so the 5x figure is unsourced as well as mis-typeset.
audit.corrected: 15% set to 10% in all three places; the multiplier and the run-together word removed while keeping the mechanic; phases[2].why moved to the cooldown model; silence replaced with the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The wave block is the generic 'frozen wave near your tower pre-6' text and never accounts for the fact that Ornn does not have to go home to buy.
audit.why: Wave plans built around punishing a recall — cheater recalls, crashing to reset, taking plates while he shops — do not generate tempo against Living Forge. That is a real and unusual constraint on the standard Kassadin script.
audit.corrected: Noted in wants.foe[2] and content.late rather than the wave block, which had no room inside the band for the extra clause.

He's reduced to a self-forged frontline body that can't pin a blink-spam assassin: I roam, splitpush, and delete his squishies while he flails — full Kassadin takeover.
edits.after: This is the dream scaling lane — Ornn doesn't reclaim relevance late the way a Kayle or Vladimir would, though Living Forge lets him buy without recalling, so he never loses tempo to a reset. notes: BLOCKED BY THE LENGTH BAND: full.diff reads HARD on a lane recorded at 72.73% over 22 games — the highest win rate in this slice — and whose own late text calls it a 'full Kassadin takeover'. 'HARD' is 4 characters and 'FAV' is 3 (-25%), so the label cannot be corrected inside the band; I moved diffRating and both rating lines instead, which now say Favoured next to a diff that still says HARD. Also blocked: content win[] and full phases[] side Ornn at levels 1-5, first item and two-plus items, where the packet's levelChart gives Kassadin level 6 onward. 'Ornn' is 4 characters against 'Kassadin' at 8 (+100%). Both need a hand fix. TYPO WORTH FIXING EVEN IF NOTHING ELSE IS: content.spikes[2].text currently renders 'Nether Blade's championrefund (5x mana on-hit)' — two words run together, and the 5x multiplier is unsourced (Riot's description says only 'restores Mana'). My replacement drops the figure and keeps the mechanic. CHAMPION-WIDE, VERIFIED ON THE WIKI: Void Stone is 10% magic damage reduction, not 15% (V11.24), and Force Pulse has not been charge-gated since V12.23 — the phases[2].why boilerplate is wrong on all 71 Kassadin matchups and the kit file still carries Riot's pre-rework tooltip, so it will regenerate unless fixed at the source. FLAG MISFIRE: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json tags Volcanic Rupture with 'grounding' and Bellows Breath with 'channel'. Riot's descriptions support neither — the Q slows and leaves terrain, the W is an advance-and-breathe. Grounding would matter enormously here, since grounding is the one status that does disable Riftwalk, so this flag is worth correcting before someone writes advice off it. I did not.
